requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Semantic ambiguity resolved by Agent 2 using Business Rule BR-01. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement reflecting the mandatory precondition (window damage) combined with an OR condition for the triggering events.

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: a window is damaged AND (the interior surveillance detects an intruder OR a door is opened without a car key)

structured_requirements.final_statement: If a window is damaged AND (the interior surveillance detects an intruder OR a door is opened without a car key), the safety system shall raise an alarm.
structuring_notes: The logical structure was resolved using the supported interpretation from AMB-01, confirming that window damage is a mandatory precondition (AND) for the alarm to trigger based on either intrusion detection OR door opening.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the mechanism or timing of the alarm raising, only that it shall occur.
